sites.name: Hue Imperial City (Hue Imperial Citadel)
sites.event: A UNESCO World Cultural Heritage site, the political power center of the Nguyen Dynasty for 143 years (1802-1945).

sites.name: Thien Mu Pagoda (Linh Mu Pagoda)
sites.event: A symbol of the ancient capital of Hue, associated with the legend of the celestial lady (Thien Mu) appearing in a dream to Lord Nguyen Hoang.

sites.name: Khai Dinh Tomb (Ung Tomb)
sites.event: The tomb with the most unique architecture of the Nguyen era, combining Eastern and Western cultures, outstanding for its porcelain mosaic art.

sites.name: Lang Co Bay
sites.event: Recognized as one of the most beautiful bays in the world (Worldbays), located at the foot of Hai Van Pass.

sites.name: Minh Mang Tomb (Hieu Tomb)
sites.event: A majestic tomb, in absolute harmony with nature, reflecting the profound Confucian ideology of King Minh Mang.

sites.name: Tam Giang Lagoon
sites.event: The largest brackish lagoon system in Southeast Asia, famous for its sunset beauty and the life of local river fishermen.

place.commune: Communes in Quang Dien, Phong Dien, Phu Vang
place.district: Quang Dien District, Phu Vang District...

sites.name: Bach Ma National Park
sites.event: A famous resort since the French colonial period with a cool climate, diverse ecosystem, and a sea-watching pavilion offering a panoramic view of Cau Hai Lagoon.

sites.name: Thanh Toan Tile-roofed Bridge
sites.event: A rare ancient tile-roofed bridge remaining in Vietnam (along with Hoi An Covered Bridge), a national-level artistic architectural relic.

sites.name: Quoc Hoc Hue High School
sites.event: The third oldest high school in Vietnam, where President Ho Chi Minh and General Vo Nguyen Giap once studied.

sites.name: Vong Canh Hill
sites.event: The best spot to admire the Perfume River from above, where the Nguyen kings and lords used to come to enjoy the scenery.

sites.name: Lap An Lagoon
sites.event: Likened to the 'Tuyet Tinh Coc' (isolated paradise) of Hue with its tranquil beauty, reflecting the clouds and sky next to Lang Co Bay.

sites.name: Perfume River
sites.event: A poetic river flowing through the heart of the city, a symbol of Hue, where Hue folk singing performances take place on the river.
